_comment: M-FP Q2 (D2-8): Relc's repeatable combat tutorial spar. Reaches Relc (12,13) via the same proven inn->floodplains->relc route combat_move_input.json uses. Covers all nine D2-8 elements: (1) skippable negative ('Another time.') asserting combat_started absent + met_relc banked; (2) real re-talk into the actual spar; (3-7) the beat-id ui_tutor_line_rendered sequence driven by real keys against the SHIPPED training_yard tutor_lines (id order: opening/first_step/pool_empty/dash/aim/first_blood/watch/wrap) -- PC dex 10 vs dummy dex 2 means PC's initiative floor (11) always exceeds the dummies' ceiling (8), so PC-always-first holds for any seed, and the beat order below is seed-robust; (8) the opacity + persistence teeth: sparred_with_relc==1, won_combat/melee_hit absent (trivial on both entity and arena suppresses _bank_action_tally entirely), no class_level_up/class_gained, relc_spar entity never entity_removed (persistent:true); (9) ONBOARDING O5 rewrite: re-talk after victory now walks the GIFT node (O3 moved the spear off the spar-accept to a post-spar meet option), banking relcs_spare_spear + given_spear_by_relc and rendering the 'press I' teaching line. Seed 9 candidate: PC-vs-dummy initiative math makes 'PC acts first' seed-independent, and 21 HP dummies vs the PC's real kit make the win itself seed-robust too (D2-7 #3).

steps._comment: Inn spawn (2,3) -> inn_door (15,3) -> floodplains (7,6).
Floodplains door (7,6) -> Relc (12,13), via (12,12) facing down -- the same route combat_move_input.json/combat_walkthrough.json use to meet him.

D2-8 #1, the skippable NEGATIVE first. 'meet' node, fresh game (met_relc unset): visible options are ['Just a traveler...', 'Keep walking.'] -- default cursor (0) picks the traveler line, banking met_relc and going to 'banter'.
steps.name: confirm

steps._comment: 'banter' node: visible options ['spear? (Spar)', "I'll behave."] -- default cursor (0) goes to spar_offer instead of ending, so we can reach the skippable decline.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct — everyone swings wrong until someone laughs at them. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse; I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are simple: you move, you hit, you don't cry.

steps._comment: 'spar_offer' node: visible options ['Ready when you are.', 'Another time.'] -- decline via index 1.
The teeth of the negative: declining never starts a fight, scoped to the whole run so far (nothing has fought yet).

D2-8 #2: re-talk and actually take the spar. 'meet' now shows the met_relc variant text; visible options are now ['What's out here...', 'Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)', 'Keep walking.'] -- spar is visible index 1.

steps._comment: D2-8 #3: opening beat -- fires on combat_started itself, rendered before the first turn_started.
PC dex 10 (+d6) vs both dummies dex 2 (+d6): PC's initiative floor (11) always exceeds the dummies' ceiling (8) -- PC opens the fight on any seed.
D2-8 #4/#5: three free move-pool steps close 3 of the 5 Chebyshev cells to the dummies at (7,3)/(7,4). Step 1 fires first_step.

steps._comment: D2-8 #6/#7: hand the rest of the fight (dummy turns + the PC's remaining turns) to autoplay -- 21 HP dummies dealing ~2 dmg vs the PC's real kit is a seed-robust win.

D2-8 #7, THE OPACITY TEETH: sparred_with_relc is the only counter banked. trivial on both the entity and the arena suppresses _bank_action_tally entirely (belt-and-braces per D2-1), so no melee_hit tally and no won_combat (on_victory is explicitly ["sparred_with_relc"] only, overriding the won_combat default) ever reach the accomplishments dict or the event log.

Q2 review note: this pair is DOCUMENTATION-GRADE, not teeth -- class events only fire from sleep() and this script never sleeps, so they pass in any run. The REAL opacity teeth are the won_combat/melee_hit absent asserts above (trivial-flag suppression); a sleep-beat opacity proof would need a walk back to the inn bed and belongs to a future script if ever needed.
D2-8 #8, PERSISTENCE: persistent:true means the victory branch never calls remove_entity -- relc_spar stays live and immediately re-fightable, no sleep required.

ONBOARDING O5 (worklist rewrite): the GIFT-NODE beat replaces the old second-spar re-talk. O3 added the 'You said you had something for me?' option to the meet node (requires sparred_with_relc, hide_when given_spear_by_relc), which shifts the post-spar option indices: with met_relc+sparred both banked and given_spear unset, the meet options are ['What's out here'(0), 'You said you had something for me?'(1), 'Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar)'(2), 'Keep walking'(3)]. Selecting index 1 banks the spear + given_spear_by_relc and walks into the gift/teaching node. (The spar's repeatability is still proven above by the persistence teeth -- relc_spar was never entity_removed.)

gift node: the 'press I' teaching line (the spear-equip nudge, spec sec.9).

payload_contains.text: My spare spear. Held gates wider than that one. Now listen — owning a weapon and HOLDING it are different things: press I, that's your pack. Put the spear in your hand before the road checks your grip. Sword arm, spear arm — the weapon you carry decides which of your moves come with you.
